aka: Mary Anne Berkmeier Meier (Find a Grave index)
summary: John's 3rd great-grandmother; daughter of the Munzingen master glazier Servatius Birkenmayer; mother of eleven, died in Hazleton in 1911.
bio: Maria Anna Birkenmayer was born 29 Mar 1837 at Munzingen and baptized 2 Apr 1837 (L 10 Nr. 1590, No. 12, fol. 135): 'Maria Anna Birkenmayer, eheliches Kind des Servatius Birkenmayer hiesigen Glasers, u. der Agatha Heizler'; the teacher Johann Schell was a witness. She was the eldest of seven children; her father died 19 Apr 1853 when she was 16, and her little brother Heinrich weeks later. She married Friedrich Mayer at Munzingen on 20 Oct 1862 (described as daughter of the late master joiner Servaz Birkenmaier and Agatha Heizler). She emigrated with him and four children c.1868. She appears as 'Anna, 33, Baden' in the 1870 Hazleton census and 'Annie, 43, wife' in 1880, when her brother Gabriel (29, gardener) lived with the family; brothers Joseph and Gabriel later lived in Sandusky, Ohio. She bore 11 children (FS). She died 30 Dec 1911 in Hazleton (PA death index 1911: 'Meier, Mary A.; file 113353; Hazleton; Dec. 30') and was buried in Hazleton (Find a Grave index 'Mary Anne Berkmeier Meier', 4KC1-M2T2). The Ancestry tree (built on a Kirchzarten assumption) shows her as 'Maria A Birkenmay… 1837–1911', daughter of Servatius and 'Maria A Heitzler 1813–1867'; research shows the mother was Agatha Heizler and the family was from Munzingen, not Kirchzarten. She is NOT the Mrs. Anna (Maria) Meier of Wilkes-Barre who died 1897. Do not confuse with the Ebringen Birkenmeyer family (New Orleans 1855) or with Maria Anna Birkenmayer (1810–1865) who married Salesius Schuhmacher.
